name: When should my local business consider implementing AEO?

mainEntity.name: When should my local business consider implementing AEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your local business should consider implementing AEO when you're looking to significantly improve your local online presence, outpace competitors, or when traditional marketing efforts are not yielding desired results. It's particularly beneficial if you operate in a competitive local market, rely heavily on foot traffic or local inquiries, or struggle to keep up with evolving search algorithm changes. Early adoption can establish a strong market position, while later adoption can help businesses recover lost visibility or scale quickly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider AEO if your local business wants to significantly improve online presence, outpace competitors, or when traditional marketing isn't enough, especially in competitive markets.
